dhp212:4:
bhayaṃ → priyebhyo jāyate śokaඃ priyebhyo jāyate bhayam 
priyebhyo vipramuktānaṃ nāsti śokaඃ kuto bhayam (avadānaśataka. 8)
dhp217:4:
piyaṃ → śīlamatu suyi sajo dhamaṭho sadhujīvano 
atmano karako sadhu ta jano kurati priu. (prā. dha. C. 24) 
dharmasthaṃ śīlasampannaṃ 
hīmantaṃ satyavādinam 
ātamanaඃ kārakaṃ śāntaṃ 
taṃ janaඃ kurute priyam (saṃskṛtadharmapada 5.24)
